capabilities: Sync Mendeley references into one note per reference
Generate stable citekeys with automatic disambiguation
Mirror Mendeley folder hierarchy for new notes
Download and embed reference PDFs on demand
Update only a delimited block, leaving user notes untouched
extras: Desktop only. Each user must register their own Mendeley application and paste its Client ID and Secret. Tokens are stored unencrypted in the plugin's data.json. Deleting a document in Mendeley does not delete the local note.
problem: Reference notes have to be built and kept up to date by hand, and Mendeley metadata, folders and PDFs stay outside the vault.

requires.name: Mendeley Client ID and Client Secret

summary: Desktop plugin that syncs a Mendeley library into one reading note per reference, with citekeys, mirrored folders and on-demand PDFs.
